Admin.createHint: Create a circle in preparation, then activate it when the members and schedule are ready.
Admin.assignLaterHint: You can assign a supervisor later. The circle remains inactive until the app admin activates it.
Admin.editHint: Update the circle’s name and description.
Admin.preferencesDescription: Choose the language and appearance of your administration workspace.
Admin.title: Platform administration
Admin.description: Create circles and appoint their supervisors. This account does not take part in learning activities.
Admin.empty: No circles yet. Create your first circle to get started.
Admin.search: Find an account by name or email
Admin.searchHint: The supervisor must first create a personal account.
Admin.replaceHint: The previous supervisor will remain a member. The new supervisor becomes the meeting host.
Admin.deleteHint: This permanently deletes the circle and its assignments, meetings and attendance. Type the circle name to confirm.
Admin.failed: Could not save. Please check the details and try again.
Admin.activeMeeting: End the active meeting before changing the supervisor or deleting the circle.
Admin.name: Circle name
Admin.activeHint: The circle workflow is enabled. Members can prepare assignments and attend meetings.
Admin.inactiveHint: Invitations, members, and schedules can be prepared. The app admin activates the circle when everyone is ready.
Admin.activateHint: The workflow will begin with the next scheduled meeting. Unfinished assignments with past dates will move to that meeting.
Admin.deactivateHint: Meetings, assignments, reminders, and attendance tracking will pause. Members, progress, and history will be kept. You can continue preparing members and schedules.
Admin.activationActiveMeeting: End the live meeting before deactivating this circle.
Admin.activationSupervisorRequired: Assign a supervisor before activating the circle.
Admin.activationScheduleRequired: Set up a meeting schedule before activating the circle.
